name: School of War
descr: Play the School of War if you want to utilize trained magic for violence.

foundations.name: Battlemage
foundations.text: You've focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

foundations.name: Face Your Fear
foundations.text: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, you deal an extra **1d10** magic damage.

specializations.name: Conjure Shield
specializations.text: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 Hope, you add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

specializations.name: Fueled by Fear
specializations.text: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **2d10**.

masteries.name: Thrive in Chaos
masteries.text: When you succeed on an attack, you can **mark a Stress** after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

masteries.name: Have No Fear
masteries.text: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **3d10.**
